content.english: Unique in his world, whose right hand is righteousness,
Loved the Father of a Multitude [Abraham], and showed him kindness.
He chose his progeny, and placed them high,

content.hebrew: הָרַס אֱלֵי קָמָיו עִם רֹב גְּאוֹנוֹ:
content.english: He destroyed their foes with his great haughtiness,
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.
He refined them in the crucible of the iron, and removed their dross.
He showed his redeemed people a type of happiness.
He established his faith, and cleared its pathways;
[God], my protection and shield, acted wondrously in his faithfulness.
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.
Abraham’s vision, in the Covenant of the Parts,
[Predicted] both sojourning and freedom for the children of the upright.

content.hebrew: דָּן עַל יְדֵי עֶשֶׂר מַכּוֹת לְצָרִים:
content.english: He judged the foes with ten plagues,
And the rock [God] poured his wrath upon those that enslaved [the Israelites],
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.

content.hebrew: קָ֒ם עַל מְרֵעִים צוּר עִם יָד חֲזָקָה:
content.english: The rock [God] attacked the evildoers, with a mighty hand,
He smote their firstborns, and caused great wailing,
He protected [pasaḥ] his nation, who were immersed in troubles.
He made much great kindness and benevolence,
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.

content.hebrew: חָ֒ס עַל יְדִידָיו צוּר חָמַל וְרִחַם
content.english: The rock [God] had compassion for his beloved people, and kindness and mercy.
With his might, he guided them with the cloud, and led them.
He showed them miracles when they waited at the sea.
He turned Pharaoh’s heart, and the heart of his multitudes,
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.

content.hebrew: זָ֒מַם אֲשֶׁר נִחַם עַל עַם יוי:
content.english: He plotted about his regretting [having let free] Adonai’s nation,
He pursued my faithful with his great army.
The rock (God) confounded them at night, with my two clouds [of cloud and of fire],

content.hebrew: בָּקַע לְיַם סוּף עַל יַד נֶאֱמָנוֹ:
content.english: He split the Reed Sea by the hand of his faithful [Moses],
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.
God sanctified the first day for his children,
To celebrate and sing with hymns, songs;

content.hebrew: גַּם יוֹם שְׁבִיעִי כִּי טִבַּע לְפָנָיו
content.transliteration: Gam yom shevi‘i ki tibba‘ lefanav
content.english: Also the seventh day, when he drowned, in their presence,
Pharaoh and his army, with his multitude of chariots,
When he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.

content.hebrew: וּ֒לְךָ אֲ֒נִי מַ֒רְבֶּה צ֒וּר שִׁיר תְּהִלּוֹת
content.transliteration: Ulcha ani marbē tsur shir tehillot
content.english: To you, O rock (God), I give much song of praise,
I recount your kindnesses, O awesome one in your deeds.
I hope and wait for you to hasten redemption,
For the hopeful prisoner to return to the fortress [Jerusalem],
[Just as] when he brought up the shepherd [Moses] and his flock out of the sea.

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב: שׁ֚וּבוּ לְבִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַתִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם־הַיּ֕וֹם מַגִּ֥יד מִשְׁנֶ֖ה אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽךְ׃ (זכריה ט:יב)
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv: Shuvu levits-tsaron asirē hattiḳva, gam hayyom maggid mishnē ashiv lach.
content.english: As it is written: Return to the stronghold, Ye prisoners of hope; Even to-day do I declare That I will render double unto thee. (Zechariah 9:12)
